encoding: All fields little-endian u64; unaligned buffers supported; caller provides live disjoint buffers and immutable source/workspace for the call. No references are retained.
frame_length: Exactly 64 + 8*pool_count + 32*line_count + 24*replacement_count + 8*inserted_count. Every intermediate operation must fit u64 before any table access. Truncated tables or extra workspace bytes are INVALID.
parse_request: pool_count=4; parse_text_id=3; line_count=replacement_count=inserted_count=preferred_ending=reserved_zero=0; pool_lengths=[1,2,1,source.len]. source is the original contents only, with strict canonical UTF8 validation. First existing CRLF/CR/LF selects preferred ending; absence defaults to LF. No terminal empty sentinel logical line.
nonparse_request: pool_count>=4; parse_text_id=reserved_zero=0; preferred_ending in1..3. source is the direct concatenation of all declared pool strings in ID order; checked sum(pool_lengths)==source.len. Pool IDs0/1/2 are fixed LF/CRLF/CR, lengths[1,2,1], and source begins with bytes 0a0d0a0d. Every pool and subspan must end on UTF8 boundaries. line_texts/contents require replacement_count=inserted_count=0.
old_lines: text_id>=3 and <pool_count; start<=pool_length and len<=pool_length-start; ending0..3. Both start and end must be UTF8 boundaries within the declared pool. Overlapping spans are allowed. Metadata modes never split a span at internal CR/LF.
replacements: apply only; new_line_count values sum exactly to inserted_count. start>=previous(start+old_length), and start+old_length<=u64::MAX. Each inserted ID is>=3 and <pool_count and denotes that entire pool string as one logical line, even with internal CR/LF.
apply: Keep actual old-line cursor separate from logical source_index. For each replacement copy min(start-source_index, remaining_old_lines), discard min(old_length, remaining_old_lines), append its next new_line_count inserted IDs, then logical source_index=start+old_length. Append remaining old lines. Preserve nonzero old endings; fill ending0 and all inserted endings with the unchanged preferred style. Empty replacements still fill absent endings. Legal MAX requests must only loop over actual remaining rows/inserts, not requested skip/delete.
parse_apply_result: One row per resulting logical line; fourth word ending0..3 (apply nonzero); logical_line_count=record_count. total_text_bytes includes all preserved/filled endings and equals future into_contents byte length.
line_texts_result: One row per logical line, fourth word0; logical_line_count=record_count; total_text_bytes is text lengths only.
contents_result: Text row for every logical line, including empty spans, followed by ending literal row when ending!=0. Literal id=ending-1,start0,len=declared literal length,fourth word0. Text rows also have fourth word0. logical_line_count is state line count, record_count counts copy fragments, total_text_bytes includes endings.
query_emit: Even operations write only the complete40B header. Odd operations write identical header and records. Before writing either kind all frame/UTF8/span/replacement checks and output counts/byte totals/size overflow checks must pass. Emit then checks full output capacity. Bytes beyond query40 or full emitted plan are preserved.

statuses.4294967294: SHORT: output<40 or workspace<64, or otherwise-valid emit lacks full required output capacity
statuses.4294967293: UTF8: malformed canonical UTF8 source in any mode

precedence: Header, exact frame size, table values, span range, replacement order/sums and source/pool extent checks (INVALID).
Complete source UTF8 validation (UTF8), then pool/span UTF8 boundary checks (INVALID), then output row/byte totals and plan-size overflow checks (INVALID).
atomicity: Every returned error preserves every source/workspace/output byte. Successful calls never write source or workspace. No pointer provenance/admission is claimed beyond live/disjoint caller preconditions.
rust_storage: One owned contiguous text backing plus native-selected logical line spans and preferred code. Parse copies original bytes once; line_texts/contents borrow current backing. Apply encodes new pool text only as needed, then copies HIA-selected spans into compact current backing and releases old backing/frame. No line splitting, style choice, replacement selection, render/reparse, or Rust algorithm fallback.
